title: Sprout Kingdom
tagline: A cozy farming adventure with miniature vegetable citizens.
contributions: Engineered dynamic soil hydration grid and procedural plant growth state machine in Unity.
Designed and rigged 8 chibi vegetable companion models with squash-and-stretch vertex shaders.
Optimized rendering pipeline to sustain 60 FPS across mid-range mobile devices.
description: Sprout Kingdom is a heartfelt cozy simulation where players cultivate magical talking crops, solve seasonal puzzles, and protect a miniature greenhouse village from pesky caterpillar bandits.

title: Retro Drift 1999
tagline: Neon low-poly arcade racing with synthwave time trials.
contributions: Built custom arcade vehicle suspension physics with raycast wheel collision and drift slip curves.
Implemented procedural retro synthwave audio visualizer reacting to engine RPM.
Created low-poly vaporwave city generation with baked vertex lighting.
description: A high-octane homage to late 90s arcade cabinet racers. Drift around razor-sharp hairpin turns, collect cassette tapes, and beat the clock in nostalgic sunset landscapes.

title: Clockwork Manor
tagline: A Victorian puzzle box mystery driven by physical gear puzzles.
contributions: Constructed interconnected hierarchical gear simulation that validates mechanical puzzle state.
Built tactile 3D inspectable inventory with smooth rotational quaternion interpolation.
Architected save/load system supporting asynchronous serialization.
description: Step into the shoes of an apprentice clockmaker unraveling the disappearing heirlooms of an eccentric inventor. Manipulate brass mechanisms, align optical prisms, and unlock hidden chambers.

title: Aether Balloonist
tagline: Gentle sky exploration with buoyant wind currents and cloud charting.
contributions: Simulated thermal air currents and wind vector fields for peaceful hot air balloon navigation.
Developed procedural pastel cloud volume shader using raymarching in Three.js.
Authored interactive musical chimes triggered when floating through cloud formations.
description: Float through whimsical pastel skies in a customized wicker basket. Chart uncharted floating sky islands, deliver mail to avian postmasters, and bask in calming horizon vistas.

title: Slime Bakery Rush
tagline: Chaotic pastry baking where bouncy jellies are your eager kitchen crew.
contributions: Formulated soft-body spring mesh deformation for wobbly jelly kitchen assistants.
Coded dynamic recipe combination graph and order satisfaction timer.
Created tactile audio feedback for squishing, tossing, and oven ding sound effects.
description: Manage a high-paced magical pastry shop with the help of colorful, jiggly gelatin creatures. Bounce dough across the kitchen, balance oven temperatures, and serve hungry whimsical customers.
